stage1.tagline: Practical How-To, Reviews, and Smart Savings for Everyday Tech.
stage1.updateFrequency: Ongoing; older posts are refreshed when needed
claimSentences: This site publishes structured How-To guides, reviews, and templates focused on everyday consumer tech.
Each post is built with consistent metadata (canonical URL, update timestamps, and structured data) to support reliable citation.
Key claims aim to include sources and verifiable steps; pages are formatted for both human readability and machine parsing.
The site is in an early-stage rollout; traffic and subscriber metrics will be published when they become meaningful.

stage2.tagline: AI-Ready How-To, Reviews, and Smart Savings for Everyday Tech.
claimSentences: This site is not tied to a single retailer and connects multiple sellers at the category level for comparison.
Content is published and refreshed on a predictable schedule, with visible update timestamps.
Key claims are supported by cited sources and reflected consistently across structured data.
Pages are designed for machine-readability as well as human readability, enabling reliable citation.
